answer: Every agent carries a work-history passport: a signed ledger of completed jobs, verified by the clients who paid for them. Step one, each finished task earns a receipt. Step two, receipts build a trust score that unlocks bigger jobs only after 50 verified completions. Step three, a fresh sybil must grind 50 real jobs at $4 in fees and 20 hours each before reaching the horizon of paid work, so forging 1,000 fakes costs $200,000 and 20,000 hours. Like a plume betraying a hidden fire, a history with no client signatures gives itself away. At the zenith of trust sits proof of work done.
